notes: Tail case re-examined. U1/U2 masks were whole persons; re-segmented to the T-shirts with SAM3 (v2). U2 replace made structural. U3 ref names the green flag (the only green one; the others are red). U4: the 'two megaphones' finding is a false positive - it is one megaphone carried under the forearm (cream bell, blue body/handle and coiled cord), split into pieces only by the forearm occlusion; mask kept, noun and payload made specific.
